subject.title: Mattermost voice calls should support interruptible multi-utterance turns

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor and bundle the Mattermost Calls voice POC in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103842, with interruptible multi-utterance turns as its intended interaction model?
rationale: The requested behavior is absent from current main and exists only within a large optional-integration proposal; the protected label and VISION.md’s high bar for bundled plugins require explicit maintainer ownership before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Sponsor and narrow the POC
options.body: Keep the issue paired with the linked PR, reduce the proposal to a reviewable boundary if necessary, and require live Mattermost correction proof before landing.

options.title: Split foundational work first
options.body: Review a smaller Calls transport and single-turn POC before accepting the concurrent batching and interruption state machine.

options.title: Route to an external plugin
options.body: Use the existing plugin boundary and maintain Mattermost Calls voice support outside this repository if no missing SDK seam is identified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and narrow the POC
recommendation.body: Keep the issue paired with the linked PR, reduce the proposal to a reviewable boundary if necessary, and require live Mattermost correction proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available prior Mattermost contribution signal and is the best routing candidate for the bundled-plugin product decision.
